title: Apple Enchant
description: Renewable Enchanted Golden Apple in a vanilla way.
body:
🍎 Apple Enchant

Reintroduces Enchanted Golden Apples through a balanced, survival-friendly mechanic.




--- ## Overview **Apple Enchant** allows you to craft Enchanted Golden Apples without breaking vanilla balance. By sacrificing your hard-earned experience levels, you can imbue standard Golden Apples with powerful magic. 🔗 **Synergy:** Highly recommended to use alongside **[Food Balance](https://modrinth.com/datapack/food-balance)** and **[Mooshroom Energy](https://modrinth.com/datapack/energy)** for expanded food mechanics! --- ## How to Enchant Transforming your golden apples requires magical mastery and raw experience: - **Requirement:** You must have **at least 30 experience levels**. - **Action:** Stand on an **Enchanting Table** and **crouch (sneak)** while holding Golden Apples in your inventory. - **Cost:** The ritual consumes exactly **1395 XP** (the exact total amount needed to go from level 0 to 30). - **VFX/SFX:** Enjoy mysterious custom sound and particle effects during the enchanting process! > Do not begin the enchanting ritual if you aren't absolutely ready to spend all 30 levels!
--- ## Disenchanting & Recovering XP Need your experience back? You can reverse the magical process: - **Cook** an Enchanted Golden Apple in a standard **Furnace** to recover the spent XP. - **Do NOT use a Campfire!** Campfires will cook the item without returning any experience. ### The Shattered Golden Apple When you successfully disenchant an apple in a furnace, you are left with a new, depleted item: the **Shattered Golden Apple**. - **Effect:** Grants **Decaying Resistance (🛡️ 100% → 0%)**. - **Drawback:** Provides **zero healing** to the player.
